scripts.preview: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages dev .vercel/output/static
scripts.deploy: npm run pages:build && wrangler pages deploy .vercel/output/static --project-name=loja-costura-e-ponto
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute sec-store-db --local --file=./database/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute sec-store-db --local --file=./database/migrations/0002_seed_data.sql
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute sec-store-db --remote --file=./database/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql --yes && wrangler d1 execute sec-store-db --remote --file=./database/migrations/0002_seed_data.sql --yes
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
